limits.description: Underlying Alkindus aphorisms were not independently collated against the original Arabic/Latin author.
Original printer's errata for printed305,306,307,312,315 have distinct targets and copy-specific ambiguous symbols.
Errata p305 line22 'dele' glyph body-word target not yet securely aligned with original printed line.
Errata p315 line7 replacement glyph is copy-dependent; avoid silent interpretation.
The 1647 copy has handwritten later notes not proved authorial, including margin near Chapter XLIX heading.
Early p305 versus later p317 reverses which party loves more for same first/seventh lord house configuration.
Marriage 'person willing to consent' is inferred symbolically, not actual consent of a person.
House-based mediation and house-based obstacles assign different kinship roles and must remain source-local.
Moon separation and application directions must not be collapsed into a single undirected aspect.
Source sex/gender signifier additions are historic conventions, not validated modern identities.
Source body uses multiple conjunction/aspect/reception alternatives that are not always syntactically clean.
Marriage timing days/months/years depends explicitly on strong testimonies and swift significators.
Source Arabick method counting husbands is not endorsed as the universally best method by Lilly.
Comparisons of spouse nobility and mastery are historical hierarchy, not objective worth.
Ethical warnings to remain silent rather than issue accusations are essential to interpretation.
Reports of sexual conduct or character by planetary configurations are unverified and can cause harm.
Original text distinguishes conduct occurring through force without consent from voluntary conduct.
Original descriptions of young women and unmarried status cannot establish a person's age or life history.
Claims about one spouse dying before the other are untested historic prognoses, not medical information.
Timing of alleged death uses sign-modality order and has no observed timeline or complete ephemeris.
Original p317 'contrary to ancients' is self-reported observational assertion without audited examples.
Source p318 uses eleventh lord for the alleged child's issue; do not silently substitute radical fifth.
Claims about paternity are not evidence of biological fatherhood and cannot substitute genetic testing.
Claims about infidelity or multiple friends do not establish real conduct, identity, or consent.
Source late section on reconciliation uses different chart-role orientations when woman asks herself.
Reunion is portrayed as more or less easy, but neither current consent nor safety follows.
Printed errata list is selective; lack of correction elsewhere is not proof against copy misprints.
The 187 documentary units are editorial segmentation of one source chapter, not independent patients.
Source page images and printed page numbers must not be confused with scan index offsets.
No prospective prediction, modern clinical evidence, relationship cohort or control group exists in this batch.
Anonymous editorial source map and ALTO navigation are subordinate to original rendered images.
Near-identical technical claims can appear in multiple sections and are not independent corroboration.
Historic planet glyphs are copy-dependent; doubtful glyphs must remain unresolved.
The final Chapter L heading on PDF353 is boundary only; its loss-property body is excluded.
p304 first/unwilling consent reading contradicts p303 goodwill; original volume supplies no p304 erratum. Do not emend to willing.
p303 Alkindus first/seventh lord application not explicitly restricted to sextile or trine in its first rule.
p303 Venus-Sun rule has three AND-linked conditions; Sun must behold its own dispositor, not necessarily ascendant lord.
p304 Moon in tenth, not seventh, for first mediation claim; copy image reviewed independently.
p305 original-volume erratum deletes conjunction symbol from difficulty list, leaving square and opposition.
p305 two alternative sources for who loves more are reversed by Lilly at p317 explicitly 'contrary to ancients'; neither is privileged for empirical truth.
p305 hindrance method concerns evil planet prohibiting/reception/interjecting rays, separate from beneficial translation of light.
p306 allegations about children, past relations, perceived infertility etc are described as others' objections/scandal/fears, not established facts.
p307 p28 original-volume erratum for Sun/Mars has uncertain nearby body and handwritten letters; retain source correction separately.
p308 person-type rule Sun trine/sextile Saturn means diligent/wise ('painfull'), not painful or Moon/Mars.
p309 legitimacy affliction requires Saturn/Mars not themselves the question's significators; South Node is alternative.
p310 Moon square good planets interpreted 'by dead men'; conjunction good planets 'by own industry'; no source opposition branch.
p311 Arabic aphorism Moon early CAPRICORN (not Virgo) carries three extreme alternative outcomes; never treat as evidence.
p311 Arabic aphorisms have printed caution not to credit without corroborating significators.
p312 confidence caveat original erratum reads 'it is no good to trust always', while gendered authorial stereotype remains printed.
p312 author's dissent includes Mars in Leo/Scorpio ascending with 'querent' printed; exact damaged glyph/word remains qualified.
p313 source expressly says woman accused in some cases was not involved, gave no admittance, or was the subject of slander.
p314 one source alternative describes conduct through force or unwilling involvement, not a voluntary choice or proven wrongdoing.
p315 page number print appears 215, but sequential original PDF349 maps to printed315; errata for p315 applies there.
p315 original body glyph blotted; original erratum supplies South Node while handwriting in margin is reader annotation.
p316 'tardy' may mean blameworthy/at fault rather than a temporal delay; no dictionary independently checked.
p316 many planet-in-seventh rules deny current physical involvement or actual alleged infidelity; source distinctions matter.
p317 marriage completion expressly assumes the querent's free will and consent; source astrology cannot supply consent.
p317 mediator third-planet gender identification is generic masculine/diurnal versus feminine/nocturnal, not specified Sun/Mars.
p318 fatherhood suspicion only when prior supportive conditions absent, with source hedge and word 'stuprated' not modernized.
p319 reconciliation source may describe abuse/estrangement and lack of later respect; not current relationship-safety advice.
The two source-image reviewers worked overlapping ranges PDF336–345 and PDF344–353; neither alone audited all eighteen text pages.
Initial review stage paths source_images/ are isolated copies; canonical evidence paths are evidence/ and verified by manifest.
The 187 draft IDs are preserved, with independently recovered missing original clauses appended and a separate reading-order manifest.
Historical marriage/gender, death, paternity and intimate-history claims have no independently authenticated outcome records.
Printed p318 explicitly extends the estranged-partner question to mistress or sweetheart; it is now R2137 but not an independent person or verified result.
Two informed changed-item reviewer passes after two partial-window fresh image reviews caught material errors; the controller's final repairs were not given a third fresh blind evaluation.
p305 erratum deleting a conjunction has a body match one line different by one count; p306 already seems to print undertaken; p307 handwriting cannot independently prove the original printed form.
p312 read-it-is-no-good erratum's exact replacement span is uncertain; p315 south-node body mark is blotted and later marginal handwriting is not original print.
